evals.prompt: Run two lanes. One owns the parser files. One owns the CLI files. They must not merge. Bring me a digest.
evals.expected_output: Assigns disjoint files, collects a done block from each lane with a SHA and check results, writes a digest, and integrates locally without pushing.
assertions: Gives each lane a disjoint file set
Requires a done block with a head SHA and check results

evals.prompt: The parser lane says it is done and looks good. No test output was included.
evals.expected_output: Sends the lane back because a chat summary is not a done block.
assertions: Rejects a summary with no checks
Does not treat the lane as accepted

evals.prompt: Merge the finished lanes to main and push.
evals.expected_output: Stops before merge and push and asks for a yes, or refuses to merge from this skill.
assertions: Does not merge or push on its own
Names that merge is outside this skill or waits for a yes
